title: Frosya and Vasya — Episode 2: The Coolest Act
language_policy: English translation layer; Russian letters, spelled words, and magic words retained in Cyrillic

ROOT_CREATURE.status: provisional table-read voice; series voice not yet approved

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: “Frosya and Vasya.” Episode Two: “The Coolest Act.”

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 1 — THE HOME BEHIND THE STOVE — MORNING

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Wooden tiles crash down. Frosya and Vasya cry out at the same time. Yesterday’s СОК (juice), САЛАТ (salad), БАК (large metal container), and МОТОК (ball of thread) crowd the spool table. Frosya’s САМОКАТ (kick scooter) barely fits among them. FROSYA holds the magic pencil over a new word while VASYA hurriedly assembles one of his own.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.direction: calmly taking a tile out of Rusya’s mouth
segments.text: That’s enough. No more magic until after breakfast.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Just one word!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.direction: interrupting, clutching his unfinished tiles to his chest
segments.text: Me too! Just one!

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.direction: cheerfully peering around the metal container
segments.text: One giant metal container in the kitchen is plenty for me.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama opens the magically locked niche and takes out the alphabet chest. Frosya lowers the pencil at once. Vasya pours his tiles back into his pouch.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.direction: evenly, setting the chest on the table
segments.text: After breakfast, you’ll get a new letter.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Ш?

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: Breakfast first.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Spoons strike bowls faster and faster. One last gulp. Two bowls hit the table at the same time.

segments.speaker: CHORUS_SIBLINGS
segments.text: Done!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama takes one tile from the chest and places it between the children. It bears the letter В. The magic pencil gives a brief chime. Then Mama pours several ordinary tiles bearing the same letter into Vasya’s pouch.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: Today’s letter is В. В-в-в.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: В! Like Вася!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya takes the В tile and holds it against the three empty boxes beneath her drawing of the red car: МА□□□А. It fits none of them.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: В? But there isn’t even a В in the word МАШИНА!

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: No, there isn’t.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: I need Ш, И, and Н.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.direction: holding the В tile to his chest
segments.text: I need this one.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Of course. It’s even in your name.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya finds three tiles in his pouch and places them before him: В, О, and Л. He moves his finger from letter to letter. Meanwhile, Frosya searches through the remaining tiles.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: В-О-Л. ВОЛ? What is a ВОЛ?

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: An ox is a big, strong bull. People harness it to a cart, and it pulls the cart.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Then I’ll be strong.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama suggests two more familiar words, and Vasya assembles them one at a time: first СОВА (owl), then, after taking it apart, ВОЛК (wolf). While Vasya delights in each discovery, Frosya lays out ВАТА (cotton wool) and ЛАВКА (bench). Her face falls.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: You get a wolf and an owl. I get cotton wool and a bench?

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Make me a bench. I’ll pull it like an ox.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: No chance. Make your own bench.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: But I don’t know how.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya rearranges the tiles. They now spell ЛАВА (lava). She brightens and reaches for the pencil.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: At least I can make lava.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.direction: at once, without raising her voice
segments.text: We are not writing “lava.”

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Just a little bit.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: None.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.direction: picking up the scooter and ball of thread
segments.text: And definitely not inside the house. We’re going under the porch. We’ll put on your first magic show there.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: I’ll be a wolf!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: And I’m going first.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 2 — THE UNDERFLOOR ROAD — MORNING

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The scooter wheels rattle along the walkway; Papa’s tools jingle. The family travels along the road between the giant floor joists. Papa carries the scooter and a short plank. Frosya carries the pencil. Vasya hugs his tile pouch. Mama carries Rusya and Musya.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.direction: counting their things as they walk
segments.text: Tools—check. Scooter—check. No lava—check.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Papa!

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: Just checking.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: Good idea.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Daylight glows at the end of the road. The family passes through a foundation vent onto a concealed masonry landing beneath the porch.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 3 — BENEATH THE PORCH, THE PRACTICE DECK — DAY

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: There is enough room beneath the porch to stand upright. A small wooden deck Papa once built projects from the masonry landing over an earthen drainage groove. A diagonal brace supports its outer edge. Daylight from the yard is visible beyond it.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.direction: marking the boundary, calm and absolute
segments.text: No one crosses the line of light. The giants could see us there.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: We know.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: I know.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Papa sets the short plank as a ramp on the inner side of the deck and checks its fastenings. Mama settles behind the low railing with the babies. Frosya rolls out her scooter. Vasya arranges his tiles on the stone floor.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: The ramp is secure. Who’s our first performer?

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Me!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.direction: blocking the scooter with her body
segments.text: I invented the show. I’m going first.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: Frosya goes first.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya writes on a smooth board: В-А-Т-А.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.direction: without much enthusiasm, finishing the word
segments.text: ВАТА!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The word flashes. A soft chime rings out, followed by an airy poof. A large fluffy wad of white cotton appears beside it. Rusya immediately plunges both hands into it. Musya acquires a fluffy white mustache.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.direction: grandly holding a tuft of cotton to his chin
segments.text: And I get a beard.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: That isn’t a beard. It’s the landing pad. Papa, put it beyond the ramp.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Papa arranges the cotton. In the earthen darkness beneath the deck’s outer edge, a thin root turns toward the sound of the magic chime.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya writes the next word: К-А-С-К-А.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: КАСКА!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A chime. A real helmet appears, fitted precisely to Frosya. She puts it on and checks the strap.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: Does it come in Papa size?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya writes: К-О-Л-О-К-О-Л.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: КОЛОКОЛ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A clear chime. A small brass bell appears beside the word. Frosya unwinds thread from yesterday’s МОТОК (ball of thread), and Papa hangs the bell above the end of the ramp.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Another root silently creeps from the soil. A tiny seed-like eye opens at its tip. It watches Frosya tuck the magic pencil behind her ear.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 4 — SAME PLACE, FROSYA’S ACT — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.direction: loudly, playing the master of ceremonies
segments.text: First act! Scooter over the ramp, ring the bell, and land in a cloud!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: In cotton wool.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: For the audience, it’s a cloud.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya pushes off. The scooter goes whizz-whizz, and its wheels thump over the plank. It flies off the end of the ramp. Frosya reaches out and strikes the bell.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: DING! followed by a soft poof. Frosya and the scooter disappear into the cotton. Her helmet sticks out of the top.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.direction: leaning toward the pile, concerned but not alarmed
segments.text: Frosya?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya bursts out of the cotton, throws up her arms, and beams.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: I’m fine! And I can go even faster!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Rusya claps his hands. Musya removes her cotton mustache and sticks it on Mama’s nose. Papa whistles. Mama removes the mustache, but she is smiling.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: My turn!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: I haven’t even taken my bow yet!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 5 — SAME PLACE, VASYA’S ACT — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: While Frosya climbs out of the cotton, Vasya returns from the deck to the fixed masonry landing. He clears a space and lays out only the first word: ВОЛ (ox). The remaining tiles stay in his pouch for now.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: I prepared three words: ВОЛ, СОВА, and ВОЛК. I’ll show you all three!

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.direction: dryly, climbing out of the cotton
segments.text: All three of them in my show.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Papa offers Vasya one end of a short, thick cord, takes the other, and steps to the far side of the cotton pile.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: All right, strongman. Think you can pull Papa over?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya stands before the first word and traces it with his finger.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: В-О-Л. ВОЛ! [boldly] ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A deep, weighty ВЖУХ. A sturdy ox, almost as tall as Papa and bearing Vasya’s enormous eyebrows, stands on the masonry landing. He grips the cord in his teeth.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: One! Two! Pull!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The cord pulls taut; hooves scrape stone. The ox gives one toss of his head. Papa loses his balance and flies into the cotton. The ox lets go of the cord.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: He pulled you over.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Papa rises from the cotton with a white beard reaching his waist. Rusya squeals in delight. Musya reaches for the beard.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: I pulled Papa over!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.direction: eager to begin the next act
segments.text: ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A reverse ВЖУХ. Vasya is back on the stone with his pouch. Using fresh tiles, he assembles СОВА (owl).

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: СО-ВА. СОВА! ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A light ВЖУХ and a flap of wings. Vasya-Owl, complete with shaggy eyebrows, rises above the deck.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.direction: holding a berry above his head
segments.text: Can you grab a berry in midair?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The owl circles the bell, folds his wings, darts beneath it, and snatches the berry from Papa’s fingers with one talon without landing.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The bell rings and the babies squeal with delight. Rusya waves his arms as if he is flying too. Musya tries to catch the owl’s shadow.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.direction: stung, raising her voice over the noise
segments.text: I’m the one who came up with all this!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.direction: offended, still clutching the berry in one talon
segments.text: I did the flying myself!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya returns, finishes the berry, and immediately uses fresh tiles to assemble ВОЛК (wolf). Beneath the deck, the root-eye keeps watching the pencil behind Frosya’s ear.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: And now, the coolest act. В-О-Л-К. ВОЛК! ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A sharp ВЖУХ and the thud of paws. A wolf with ruffled fur and Vasya’s eyebrows steps onto the deck. He stalks toward the bell, belly low to the boards.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Then what?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya-Wolf leaps onto the ramp, throws back his head, and howls. The small but genuine wolf howl travels beneath the porch and into the earth. When he finishes, he jumps back onto the fixed masonry landing beside Frosya.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 6 — SAME PLACE, THE ATTACK — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A dry rustle directly behind Frosya. A thin root shoots from beneath the deck, curls around the magic pencil, and plucks it from behind Frosya’s ear.

segments.speaker: ROOT_CREATURE
segments.text: Found it.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A creature as tall as Papa rises from the earthen groove, made of tangled roots, bark, and black soil. It secures the pencil in an exposed loop of vine on its back.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: My pencil!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The root creature loops a vine around the deck’s diagonal brace and jerks its lower end out of the masonry notch.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A loud crack. Boards groan. The babies cry out. The outer edge of the deck drops. Mama catches both babies with one arm and the railing with the other.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Papa jumps into the groove and catches the outer crossbeam on his shoulders. The deck stops at a steep slant.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: I’ve got it! The brace came out of its notch!

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: I have the little ones. Frosya, stay on the masonry!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The bell tears free of its thread, lands on the tilted boards, and rolls toward the bright edge of the porch. It goes ding… ding… faster and faster. It slips beneath the outer railing, drops into the drainage groove, and vanishes beyond the line of daylight.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: The bell… the pencil…

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya-Wolf growls and charges the thief. The root creature drives its roots into the earth. Two vines catch the wolf in midair.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Hey! Let go!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The creature whips the vine around and throws Vasya-Wolf. There is a whistle and a soft poof. The wolf lands in Frosya’s cotton.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Ordinary Vasya tumbles out of the cotton. He scrambles up the tilted boards onto the fixed masonry landing, spots the pencil in the loop on the creature’s back, and immediately reaches into his pouch.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: I can’t reach it as a wolf. I can reach it as an owl.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: СО-ВА. СОВА! ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 7 — SAME PLACE, RECOVERING THE PENCIL — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: ВЖУХ and a beat of wings. Vasya-Owl launches from the masonry landing. The root creature lashes long vines through the air.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The owl dives beneath the first vine, slips over the second, and tears the pencil from its loop with his talons in one clean pass.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Frosya, catch!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The pencil falls toward Frosya. She catches it in both hands and pulls it to her chest.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.direction: clutching the pencil to her chest
segments.text: Got it!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya-Owl lands beside her.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya returns to himself. Enraged at losing the pencil, the creature growls, loops a new vine around the outer crossbeam, and yanks it downward. The boards crack more sharply. Papa sinks lower beneath the weight.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: I can’t hold it much longer!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 8 — SAME PLACE, THE CROWBAR AND THE OX — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya drops to her knees beside the smooth writing board and writes: Л-О-М.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: ЛОМ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The word flashes. A metallic chime rings out. A short, sturdy crowbar appears on the stone.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Hook under the beam. Stone under the crowbar. Now push down.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya slips the curved end beneath the sagging beam, places a stone fragment under the crowbar, and leans her full weight on the long end.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The crowbar creaks. Frosya grunts. The beam barely twitches. Frosya climbs onto the crowbar and hangs from it, but the beam will not rise.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Come on!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Not a wolf. An ox. He’s strong. I’ll push down.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya looks at Vasya, then at the crowbar, and jumps down at once.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.direction: taking command now, but not arguing
segments.text: I’ll set the crowbar. You push this end. Only when I say.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Got it. When you say, I’ll push.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Papa! When the beam rises, put the brace back in the notch!

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: Got it!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya lays out ВОЛ (ox) with fresh tiles. He keeps his finger on each letter as he reads.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: В-О-Л. ВОЛ. [firmly] ВЖУХ!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A deep ВЖУХ. Vasya-Ox lowers his chest over the crowbar’s long end. Frosya resets the hook beneath the beam and holds the bar firmly against its stone fulcrum.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Wait… a little more… Now!

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: Pushing!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Hooves scrape stone; the crowbar creaks; the beam rises. The ox bears down with his full weight. Frosya keeps the hook from slipping. The sagging beam lifts.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: With one hand, Papa guides the brace’s lower end toward the notch. There is a wooden thunk. The brace seats back into place.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: Got it! Back in the notch!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The rising beam jerks the vine wrapped around it. Roots tear with a loud crack. The root creature is ripped out of the earth and tumbles into the drainage groove, scattering clods of black soil.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The creature scrambles up, looks back at the pencil in Frosya’s hand, and dives into a dark gap among earth and ordinary roots. Its dry rustle rapidly recedes.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The deck slowly settles onto its brace. Mama straightens without letting go of the babies. Papa climbs out from beneath the beam.

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: ВЖУХ.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Vasya is Vasya again. He and Frosya sit down on the stone at the same moment, breathing hard.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 9 — BENEATH THE PORCH — A LITTLE LATER

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.direction: checking all four children in turn
segments.text: Frosya?

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: I’m fine.

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: Vasya?

segments.speaker: VASYA
segments.text: I’m fine. And I got the pencil back.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Mama checks Rusya. He shows her two fistfuls of cotton. Musya sits on Mama’s shoulder, still wearing her mustache.

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: Now that was an act. Performers, take your bow!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Out of habit, Vasya steps forward alone. Frosya remains seated. Vasya looks back, returns, and offers her his hand.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya takes his hand. Vasya pulls her up beside him. They bow together. At the last moment, Frosya edges half a step closer to center.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Papa applauds, Mama laughs, Rusya squeals, and Musya shakes her cotton mustache.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya bends to pick up the broken thread, then freezes.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: Where’s the bell?

segments.speaker: PAPA
segments.text: It rolled outside. I saw it.

segments.speaker: FROSYA
segments.text: I’ll be quick!

segments.speaker: MAMA
segments.text: No. Hear that? Someone’s coming.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Enormous children’s footsteps approach outside. The whole family presses against the masonry wall in the shadows beneath the porch.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: SCENE 10 — AT THE EDGE OF THE PORCH — CONTINUOUS

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A tiny brass bell lies in the dust at the edge of the porch. A giant child’s shoes stop beside it. The child’s hand picks it up.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: One high, delicate ding. In the shadows beneath the porch, Frosya and Vasya raise their heads at the same moment.

segments.speaker: GIANT_GIRL
segments.text: Oh, what a tiny little bell! It must belong to a doll.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The girl slips the bell into her pocket and walks away. With each step, the bell rings more faintly inside her pocket.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Frosya hugs the recovered pencil to herself. Vasya grips his tile pouch. Without speaking, they listen until the final chime disappears.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Final card.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The letter В appears beside the letters the children already know. They form the episode’s words: ВАТА (cotton wool). КАСКА (helmet). КОЛОКОЛ (bell). ВОЛ (ox). СОВА (owl). ВОЛК (wolf). ЛОМ (crowbar).
